item.title: How Leopold Aschenbrenner built a $45 billion AI hedge fund — and lost most of it in days
item.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner, a former OpenAI researcher-turned-hedge fund manager, saw a dramatic decline this week in his AI-focused fund, Situational Awareness.

item.title: As Warsh’s Fed faces pressure to act on inflation, these indicators show it’s at its lowest in years
item.description: Trimmed mean measures are painting a different picture than the headline numbers.

item.title: Trump's AI executive order nears key deadline as regulation debate intensifies
item.description: OpenAI's Sam Altman and Nvidia's Jensen Huang were among tech leaders in Washington, D.C., ahead of a deadline the White House set in its AI executive order.

item.title: S&P 500 closes higher Friday as Amazon surges; Dow posts fourth straight winning month: Live updates
item.description: The major averages rose on Friday, but the Dow Industrials was the only index to post monthly gains in July.

item.title: Soccer-FIFA scraps World Cup sell-off plan after resistance from members
item.description: FIFA said on Friday it will not proceed with its proposal to sell a piece of its business empire to outside investors after the project was met with fierce resistance from some of its member associations.

item.title: Scoop up more yield amid Fed rate uncertainty with these portfolio tweaks
item.description: The prospect of higher-for-longer interest rates is starting to look like more of a sure thing. That means an opportunity is coming in short-term fixed income.

item.description: President Donald Trump had touted the Reflecting Pool update, one of many renovations in D.C. he ordered ahead of America's 250th birthday celebrations.

item.title: Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft added nearly $1.5 trillion in combined value this week
item.description: Amazon, Microsoft and Google added hundreds of billions of dollars to their market caps, while Apple and Meta saw their market valuations fall.

item.title: Trump appeals order that slammed his IRS lawsuit and referred his lawyer to bar
item.description: Trump had sued the IRS for $10 billion over the leak of his tax information by an agency contractor.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has 'not agreed to' grant Ukraine Patriot missile licenses
item.description: President Donald Trump said the U.S. hasn't agreed to grant Ukraine licenses to produce Patriot missile systems.

item.title: 450,000 defrauded student loan borrowers are eligible for debt forgiveness — here's who qualifies

item.description: The prices for used electric vehicles have risen this year, which is unusual, experts said. Affordability and high gas prices help explain why, they said.

item.title: Analysis: Markets heard a dovish Kevin Warsh. The Fed chairman's own words suggest a rate hike

item.title: FIFA tests the limits of private equity in sports with World Cup subsidiary sale
